title: The Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) Method for Time Series Arising from Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33354v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems. CLOCK embeds observed sequences into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via a time-averaged occupation kernel, enabling trajectory comparison through their RKHS norm. For systems governed by differential equations, this formulation rigorously approximates the kernel mean embedding of the invariant Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen (SRB) measure, meaning our dissimilarity metric approximates the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between attractors. To accommodate general time series, we introduce time lags via Takens' Embedding Theorem to reconstruct the phase space. Crucially, CLOCK natively handles trajectories of unequal lengths and irregularly-spaced observations. We validate the proposed metric using spectral clustering, demonstrating superior performance against benchmark methods on bot

translated_title: 面向动力系统时间序列的聚类占据核（CLOCK）方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了聚类占据核（Clustering Occupation Kernel, CLOCK）方法，这是一种新颖的基于表示的框架，用于对源自动力系统的时间序列进行聚类。CLOCK通过时间平均占据核将观测序列嵌入到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中，从而能够通过其RKHS范数对轨迹进行比较。对于由微分方程支配的系统，该表述严格逼近不变Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen（SRB）测度的核均值嵌入，这意味着我们的相异性度量近似于吸引子之间的最大均值差异（MMD）。为了适用于一般时间序列，我们借助Takens嵌入定理引入时间延迟以重构相空间。至关重要的是，CLOCK能够原生处理不等长的轨迹以及不规则间隔的观测数据。我们使用谱聚类对所提出的度量进行了验证，在机器人（原文在此处截断）……基准方法上展现出更优越的性能。
tldr: CLOCK方法通过时间平均占据核将动力系统时间序列嵌入再生核希尔伯特空间，其相异性度量严格逼近吸引子间SRB测度的最大均值差异（MMD），并能原生处理不等长和不规则采样的轨迹以实现高效聚类。
en_tdlr: The CLOCK method embeds time series from dynamical systems into an RKHS via time-averaged occupation kernels, yielding a dissimilarity metric that rigorously approximates the MMD between attractors' SRB measures while natively handling trajectories of unequal lengths and irregularly-spaced observations for clustering.
